function.name: get_adriel_list_projects

function.name: get_adriel_education
function.description: Retrieve the educational background information for an individual named Adriel, including the institutions attended, degrees earned, and years of attendance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

person_id.description: The unique identifier for the person whose educational background is being requested. This should be in the format of a UUID.

include_certifications.description: A flag to determine whether to include certifications along with formal education.

fields.description: An array of strings specifying which fields of the educational background to include in the response, such as ['institution', 'degree', 'year'].
